changelog: Organizations (dealership teams): if the Accounts Hub assigns your email to an organization, Snake's Hustle now shares ONE data pool (inventory, leads, photos) with every member of that org, your Directeur/Vendeur role comes from the hub (locked in the account menu — no more self-serve switch), the account menu shows your real dealership name, and the lead-capture link becomes a team inbox. Solo accounts keep working exactly as before. Includes new Firestore security rules (deployed) gating org data by the hub-mirrored member roster, and the lead-intake function now accepts org links.
